dem.dataset: Original Product Resolution (OPR) Digital Elevation Model (DEM)
dem.source: USGS 3DEP Original Product Resolution DEM, NV_ClarkCounty_B22, work unit NV_ClarkCo_2_B22 (published 2023-06-14); NAD83(2011) Nevada East and NAVD88 (GEOID18), both in US survey feet, 1 ft cells
dem.licence: USGS public domain. Access constraints: "None." Credit: "Acknowledgement of the USGS 3D Elevation Program would be appreciated in products derived from these data."

footprints.split_why: Resorts are drawn as one building holding podium and towers: a tower drawn across a casino (the Eiffel Tower over Paris) is cut out of it first and each piece keeps its own building's height, and where only building parts carry the towers (MGM Grand, New York-New York, Westgate) the footprint is cut into its parts and its podium

succession.dry_why: The Mojave: NLCD's barren land and shrub/scrub are desert pavement and creosote, which grow no green; developed open space (golf courses, the Strip's medians) is watered and stays grown

world.sea_source: No sea in the frame, and none within 350 km; heights are NAVD88 (GEOID18) as the survey gives them

places.name: South Strip
places.why: the resorts from Mandalay Bay to Excalibur; OpenStreetMap maps the Strip as no place

places.name: Center Strip
places.why: Bellagio, Caesars Palace, Paris and the LINQ

places.name: North Strip
places.why: Wynn, Encore, Resorts World, Fontainebleau and the Sahara

places.name: Naked City
places.why: the old neighbourhood under the Strat, by its name

places.name: Las Vegas Convention Center
places.why: a district of exhibition halls and their lots

places.name: Harry Reid International Airport
places.why: the airport's north end: its terminals, concourses and runways

places.name: Las Vegas Country Club
places.why: the neighbourhood round its golf course, mapped as a golf course, not a place

obelisks.name: Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas
obelisks.why: on the Bali Hai golf course west of the boulevard, 260 m from the sign in its median, which holds no deck: a lantern at the Strip's south gate, facing the sign

obelisks.name: Sphere
obelisks.why: on open ground 200 m north of the Sphere, whose lots hold no deck: an eye beside the Sphere, which shows one, broadside to the Strip

obelisks.name: The Strat
obelisks.why: on a lot 330 m south-west of the tower, clear of its 350 m: broadside down the Strip, its index swinging as the tower's rides do

future.spans_why: None: no bridge in the frame crosses water
future.wrecks_why: None: no water in the frame holds a hull
